purchased_interfaces.thread_form: R1/8-compatible printed tapered socket; right-hand 55 degree rounded Whitworth, 28 TPI, 1:16 diameter taper. Matched seated male cone, not ISO-gauged Rc entry.
purchased_interfaces.allowance_status: Provisional first-fit PLA allowances on the shoulder-seated cone; not a calculated or physically qualified fit. Coarse M16/M26 allowances do not apply.
purchased_interfaces.modeled: Complete rounded tapered helical female socket, shoulder-stopped. Stop tightening when the fitting hex seats; do not use taper interference as a seal.
purchased_interfaces.root_closure_status: Root core follows the envelope of axially widened rounded grooves: R−sqrt(R²−flank²), plus0.01 mm radial root relief. Total root lift about0.02047 mm closes the conical sweep strictly below one pitch. Crest/flank geometry retained; mechanical first-fit retainer, not an ISO gauge-class form.

tube.guide_transition_status: A funnel behind the purchased socket joins the 4.4 mm guide to the 10.2 mm tip relief. Its length is derived from those radii and the angle; neck-down printing needs no internal scaffold in the checked factory slice. External supports remain.
tube.reference_insertion_status: Nominal 29 mm collet station from purchased 18 overall /7 thread drawing minus inside tip −25 =54 mm insertion. Mark against the actual fitting and verify full PTFE passage before use.
tube.workflow: Keep the outlet mounted permanently. Hold the detached PTFE lead free end away from the mounted outlet for hand access. Thread filament into that detached lead and feed it until it emerges at the printer end. Then slide the PTFE lead along the filament into the outside fitting and through the body to its checked insertion mark. Reconnect the printer after filament emerges. Remove the entire PTFE lead for storage; the outlet stays mounted.
